name: dsh-oh-my-claude
description: Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): live model list, session resume, images, tool activity

scripts.test: bun src/adapter.test.ts && bun src/sessions.test.ts && bun src/transcript.test.ts && bun src/mcp.test.ts && bun src/mcp-add-remove.test.ts && bun src/usage.test.ts && bun src/permissions.test.ts && bun src/client/pageSessions.test.ts && bun src/client/restore.test.ts && bun src/client/spinner.test.ts && bun src/client/turns.test.ts && bun src/client/tune.test.ts && bun src/client/settings.test.ts && bun src/keeper.test.ts && bun src/state.test.ts && bun src/memory.test.ts
scripts.build:client: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/client/index.tsx --format=cjs --target=browser --outfile=lib/client.js --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external '@deepseek-ai/*' --banner='window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-oh-my-claude", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;' --footer='return module.exports; } });'
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:client
scripts.check: oxlint src/ --max-warnings=0 && oxfmt --check src/ && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
